#######################################
# Number of samples
#######################################

```{r Summarize number of samples}

meta <- samples %>%
  filter(Diet_collection != "NA"
         & !is.na(Diet_collection)
         & !grepl("EMPTY", Sample_ID))

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Couple-Sample-collection", "Sample-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

for (sid in unique(meta$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- meta %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Subject_ID, Sample_ID, Kit_ID, Sample_origin2, Region, Collection_date, Collection_time, Transit_time_h, pH, Bristol_score) %>%
    arrange(Collection_date, Collection_time, Region)
  
  # print table to pdf nicely
  gt(temp) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
              locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
    gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Sample-collection/Sample-breakdown/Sample-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Couple-Sample-collection", "Kit-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

for (sid in unique(kits$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- kits %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Kit_ID, Subject_ID, Timepoint, Ingestion_date, Ingestion_time, Saliva, Cap_R1, Stool) %>%
    arrange(Timepoint)
  
  # print table to pdf nicely
  gt(temp) %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
              locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
    gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Sample-collection/Kit-breakdown/Kit-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}

meta_counts <- meta %>%
  
  # Count samples per region
  group_by(Subject_ID, Region) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Region_grouped = ifelse(Region %in% c("R1", "R2", "R3", "R4"), "Regions", Region)) %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID, Region_grouped) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = sum(n_samples), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Add total_samples and unique_capscan as extra "regions"
  group_by(Subject_ID) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarise(
      ., 
      Region_grouped = c("Total", "Devices"),
      n_samples = c(
        sum(n_samples),
        n_distinct(meta$Capscan_ID[meta$Subject_ID == unique(Subject_ID) 
                                      & !meta$Capscan_ID %in% c("NA", "Missing") & !is.na(meta$Capscan_ID)] )
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Region_grouped = factor(Region_grouped, levels = c("Stool", "Regions", "Devices", "Saliva", "Total")))

g <- ggplot(meta_counts, aes(x = Subject_ID, y = Region_grouped, fill = n_samples)) +
     geom_tile(color = "black") +
     geom_text(aes(label = n_samples), color = "black", size = 2) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
     coord_fixed() + 
     labs(title = "Samples per subject by region", x = "Subject ID", y = "Region", fill = "Count") +
     theme_custom_text() +
     theme(axis.text.x = element_text(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
      guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      ticks.colour = "black",
      frame.colour = "black",
      frame.linewidth = 0.2))

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-Sample-collection/Samples-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 5)


capsule_counts <- meta %>%
  filter(Region %in% c("R1", "R2", "R3", "R4")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`16S_filename`)) %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID, Capscan_ID, Subject_no) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(`16S_filename`)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

avg_regions <- round(mean(capsule_counts$n_samples, na.rm = TRUE), 2)

counts <- capsule_counts %>%
  count(n_samples, Subject_no)

g <- ggplot(counts, aes(x = factor(n_samples), y = n, fill = Subject_no)) +
     geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
     theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
     labs(x = "Number of regions", y = "Count") +
     theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
           legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
           legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
     theme_custom_text()
     

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-Sample-collection/Capsule-regions-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 2)

```

#######################################
# Ingestion and collection timeline
#######################################

```{r Individual ingestion times}

meta <- samples %>%
    filter(Kit_ID != "Unknown")

for (sid in unique(meta$Subject_ID)) {
  
  df <- meta %>% 
      filter(Sample_origin2 == "Cap", Subject_ID == sid, Ingestion_week %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) %>%
      select(Kit_ID, Ingestion_time, Ingestion_date_reformat, Diet_ingestion, Collection_time, Collection_date_reformat, Diet_collection, Transit_time_h) %>%
      unique()
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        Top_stage = paste(Ingestion_date_reformat, Ingestion_time, Kit_ID, sep = " | "),
        Bottom_stage = paste(Collection_date_reformat, Collection_time, sep = " | ")
      )
    
    g <- ggplot(df,
           aes(axis1 = Top_stage,
               axis2 = Bottom_stage,
               y = 1)) +
      geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Ingestion_date_reformat), width = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_stratum(width = 0.25, fill = "grey80", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1 ) +
      geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Ingestion date & time, Kit_ID",
                                  "Collection date & time"),
                       expand = c(.1, .1)) +
      theme_custom_text() +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            axis.title.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
            axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
            panel.background = element_blank())

  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Sample-collection/Timeline-breakdown/Alluvial-plot-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 2.5 *length(meta_fixed$Sample_origin) + 0.4, width = 5 )
}


background_df <- data.frame(
  xmin = as.POSIXct(c("2024-08-04 00:00:00", 
                      "2024-08-11 00:00:00",
                      "2024-08-18 00:00:00",
                      "2024-08-25 00:00:00",
                      "2024-09-01 00:00:00",
                      "2024-09-02 00:00:00",
                      "2024-09-05 00:00:00",
                      "2024-09-08 00:00:00")),
  xmax = as.POSIXct(c("2024-08-10 23:59:59",
                      "2024-08-17 23:59:59",
                      "2024-08-24 23:59:59",
                      "2024-08-31 23:59:59",
                      "2024-09-01 23:59:59",
                      "2024-09-04 23:59:59",
                      "2024-09-07 23:59:59",
                      "2024-09-14 23:59:59")),
  fill = c("#a31301", "#e94d0c", "#feaa33", "#cdec34", "#69fd66", "#18dac7", "#458efe", "#3e378f")
)

for (sid in unique(meta$Subject_ID)) {
  # Filter and clean metadata for this subject
  df <- meta %>% 
      filter(Sample_origin2 == "Cap", Subject_ID == sid, Ingestion_week %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)) %>%
      select(Kit_ID, Ingestion_time, Ingestion_date, Ingestion_date_reformat, Diet_ingestion, Collection_time, Collection_date, Collection_date_reformat, Diet_collection, Transit_time_h) %>%
      unique()
  
  meta_fixed <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Ingestion_datetime  = ymd_hm(paste(Ingestion_date, Ingestion_time), tz = "UTC"),
      Collection_datetime = ymd_hm(paste(Collection_date, Collection_time), tz = "UTC"),
      x_center = Ingestion_datetime + (Collection_datetime - Ingestion_datetime)/2,
      x_width = as.numeric(difftime(Collection_datetime, Ingestion_datetime, units = "secs"))
    )
  
  # Plot timeline
  g <- ggplot(meta_fixed, aes(y = Kit_ID)) +
    geom_rect(data = background_df, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = fill), alpha = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    geom_tile(aes(x = x_center, width = x_width, height = 0.8), fill = "white", color = "black") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    geom_text(aes(x = x_center, label = sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(Transit_time_h))), color = "black", size = 2) +
    scale_linetype_identity() +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%m/%d", date_breaks = "1 day") +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.background = element_blank()) +
    theme_custom_text()
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Sample-collection/Timeline-breakdown/Capscan-calendar-", sid,".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 8, height = dim(df)[1]*.15 + 2)
  
}


```

```{r Summarize ingestion times}

# Filter and clean metadata
df2plot <- meta %>% 
    filter(grepl("Capscan", Sample_origin)) %>%
    filter(Transit_time_h != 0) %>%
    select(Subject_ID, Kit_ID, Sample_origin, Capscan_ID, Transit_time_h) %>%
    distinct()

df2plot <- df2plot %>%
  mutate(Transit_time_h = ifelse(is.na(Transit_time_h), 0, Transit_time_h)) %>%
  mutate(Transit_time_h = as.numeric(Transit_time_h))

avg_transit <- mean(df2plot$Transit_time_h, na.rm = TRUE)

g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Transit_time_h > 0), aes(x = Transit_time_h)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "blue", color = "black", boundary = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
   geom_vline(xintercept = avg_transit, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150)) +
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = avg_transit + 25, y = max(40),
    label = paste("Avg:", round(avg_transit, 1), "h"), 
    color = "red", angle = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2
  ) +
  labs(x = "Transit time (h)", y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  theme_custom_text()
  
ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Sample-collection/Transit-time-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 2)

avg_transit_by_subject <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Subject_ID) %>%
  summarise(avg_transit = mean(Transit_time_h, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

df2plot <- df2plot %>%
  left_join(avg_transit_by_subject, by = "Subject_ID")

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Transit_time_h)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "blue", color = "black", boundary = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = avg_transit), color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Subject_ID, scales = "fixed", ncol = 5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of transit time", x = "Transit time (hours)", y = "Count") +
  geom_text(data = avg_transit_by_subject,
            aes(x = avg_transit + 45, y = 5, label = paste("Avg:", round(avg_transit, 1), "h")),
            color = "red", angle = 0, vjust = 0, size = 2,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +  # important to use only the data in avg_transit_by_subject
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory,"/Couple-Sample-collection/Transit-time-facet-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 5, width = 5)

```

#######################################
# PANAS
#######################################

```{r PANAS}

data_lf <- panas %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Positive_affect_score, Negative_affect_score), names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Affect_score", 
                 values_drop_na = FALSE)

data_lf <- data_lf %>%
  mutate(Direction = gsub("_.*", "", Direction))

data_lf <- data_lf %>%
  mutate(Direction = recode(Direction,
                            "Positive" = "P",
                            "Negative" = "N"))

g <- ggplot(data_lf, aes(x = Direction, y = Subject_ID, fill = Affect_score, label = Affect_score)) + 
     geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) + 
     facet_nested(cols = vars(Day), scales = "free_y", space = "free", drop=TRUE) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
     geom_text(size = 2) +
     scale_x_discrete("Affect score, by day (negative & postiive)") +
     theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
           axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           panel.background = element_blank(),
           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
           legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
           legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
     theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Couple-PANAS/PANAS-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 5)

data_lf <- panas %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Interested, Distressed, Excited, Upset, Strong, Guilty, Scared, Hostile, Enthusiastic, Proud, Irritable, Alert, Ashamed, Inspired, Nervous, Determined, Attentive, Jittery, Active, Afraid), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Score", 
                 values_drop_na = FALSE)

for (sid in unique(panas$Subject_ID)) {

g <- ggplot(data_lf %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid), aes(x = Parameter, y = Day, fill = Score)) + 
     geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) + 
     facet_nested(cols = vars(Subject_ID), scales = "free_y", space = "free", drop = TRUE) +
     scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", limits = c(1, 5)) +
     scale_x_discrete("Parameter") +
     theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
           axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
           axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           panel.background = element_blank(),
           strip.text = element_text(angle = 0),
           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
           strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
           legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +  # Size of the legend keys (symbol or color box) 
           guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1,     # Number of columns in the legend
                           byrow = TRUE)) + # Fill the legend items by row
      theme_custom_text()

# Save composition figure
ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-PANAS/Components/PANAS-components-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 3, height = 2)
}

```

#######################################
# Bristol stool score
#######################################

```{r Summarize bristol stool score}

stool <- samples %>%
  filter(Sample_ID %in% kits$Stool) %>%
  filter(!Sample_ID %in% duplicate_samples) #

stool <- stool %>%
  mutate(Sample_origin = str_remove(Sample_origin, "Stool"))

stool_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(7)


g <- ggplot(stool, aes(x = Sample_origin, y = Subject_ID, fill = Bristol_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stool_colors, na.value = "black") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Bristol Stool Scores", x = "Collection timepoint", y = "Subject ID", fill = "Bristol Score") +
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-Sample-collection/Bristol-stool-score-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 4, width = 4)

counts <- stool %>%
  count(Bristol_score)

avg_BSS <- round(mean(as.numeric(stool$Bristol_score), na.rm = TRUE), 2)

g <- ggplot(counts %>% filter(Bristol_score != "NA"), aes(x = factor(Bristol_score), y = n, fill = Bristol_score)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stool_colors, na.value = "black") +
  labs(x = "Bristol stool score", y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory,"/Couple-Sample-collection/Bristol-stool-score-distribution.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", height = 1.5, width = 2)
```
